Notes:
Because the department's curriculum changes over time, the department's Undergraduate Director may approve other appropriate Communication courses to meet the requirements for each track.
Courses required for the Communication major, but taken outside COMM, may be used to satisfy general education requirements.
Only 3 credits of COMM386 may apply toward the major.
No course grade below the grade of "C-" may count toward the major.
An overall GPA of 2.0 in the major is required for graduation.

## Department page (https://shadygrove.umd.edu/academics/degree-programs/ba-communication)

Program Overview
Be a part of one of the top 10 most popular majors at the University of Maryland while taking advantage of the convenience of Shady Grove.
The B.A. in Communication offers a curriculum in the Communication Studies track, with a specialization in Media and Digital Communication. Coursework focuses on traditional and digital media communication with courses such as strategic communication, event planning, filmmaking, social media analytics, and more. In addition to earning the B.A. from the University of Maryland, graduates acquire an excellent foundation for careers in business, government, health, education, social and human services, social media management, film production, graphic design, and more.
The B.A. in Communication is offered through the University’s College of Arts and Humanities (ARHU), which prepares versatile and visionary leaders equipped to address the complexities of the human experience—globally and locally. Maryland ARHU – Be Worldwise. Get Worldready.

How to Apply
Students entering the program at Shady Grove will have completed their associates degree, or have earned 50-60 transferable credits from a community college or accredited 4-year institution. The program can be completed full-time, or part-time. Admissions for University of Maryland Shady Grove undergraduate programs are through the University of Maryland, College Park Office of Undergraduate Admissions.
